$comment: Response to filesystem.store (ADR 0026). No mime: this path does not judge content type, and a field nobody can fill honestly is a field that will one day be filled dishonestly. size has minimum 0 where filesystem-uploaded has 1 - deliberately, because an empty file is uploadable and a zero-byte image is not.

path.$comment: Workspace-relative, and chosen by the user rather than by the daemon - so unlike filesystem-uploaded.path there is no fixed shape to pin, only the same containment rule every relative path obeys.
